_comment: Alert definitions for the ClickShop ClickStack instance. The ClickStack alerts API (POST /api/v2/alerts on OSS, or POST https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/<ORG_ID>/services/<SERVICE_ID>/clickstack/alerts on Managed ClickStack) requires the dashboardId and tileId assigned at import time, plus a webhook channel. Fill in the placeholders after importing the dashboards, or create the alerts in the UI (tile menu > Create alert) with the values below.

alerts.name: ClickShop API p95 latency > 2s
alerts.message: p95 latency of clickshop-api server spans exceeded 2000 ms over the last 5 minutes. Check the API Health dashboard: slowest routes table and recent error spans.

alerts.name: ClickShop API error spike
alerts.message: More than 25 error spans on clickshop-api in the last 5 minutes (roughly > 5% error rate at current traffic). Triage with the Recent error spans tile.

alerts.name: ClickShop telemetry ingestion stopped
alerts.message: Log ingestion dropped below 1 record in the last 15 minutes. The OTel collector on EC2 or the OTLP export to ClickStack is likely down.

alerts.name: ClickShop payment webhooks stalled
alerts.message: No 'Payment webhook received' event in the last hour. The business flow may be interrupted (payments simulator, web app, or ingestion).

alerts.name: ClickShop AI agent pipeline errors
alerts.message: More than 10 error spans on clickshop-librechat in the last 15 minutes. LLM calls, MCP tools, or the RAG pipeline are failing.
